description: Regenerate a crate's bindings (lib.rs, index.cjs, js.rs) from the signatures in src/port.rs, after changing them, adding any new batch classes. Never touches port.rs.

batch.description: Batch classes to add, `function:param`: the function runs over many `param` values kept in Rust, on all cores, in one call. A `<Function>Index` struct in port.rs replaces the default per-item loop.

crate.description: Folder of the generated crate (holds rust-anything.json).

name: refresh
title: Regenerate bindings
